6th Grade · Theme 1 · School Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece sits with her classmates for lessons. Their teacher writes on the board in this room. It is their ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) classroom

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece sits with her classmates for lessons. Their teacher writes on the board in this room.” Bu tarif “classroom” kelimesine uyar; classroom = sınıf. Diğer şıklar: school garden (okul bahçesi), playground (oyun alanı), teachers' room (öğretmenler odası).

2

Mert studies a plant with special equipment. His teacher helps him do an experiment safely. They are in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) science lab

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert studies a plant with special equipment. His teacher helps him do an experiment safely.” Bu tarif “science lab” kelimesine uyar; science lab = fen laboratuvarı. Diğer şıklar: canteen (kantin), sports field (spor sahası), lunch hall (yemekhane).

3

Selin wants a new story to read. She visits a quiet place with many books to borrow. She goes to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) library

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin wants a new story to read. She visits a quiet place with many books to borrow.” Bu tarif “library” kelimesine uyar; library = kütüphane. Diğer şıklar: conference hall (konferans salonu), classroom (sınıf), playground (oyun alanı).

4

Bora's classroom has a small area with cushions and books. He sits there to read during free time. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) reading corner

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora's classroom has a small area with cushions and books. He sits there to read during free time.” Bu tarif “reading corner” kelimesine uyar; reading corner = okuma köşesi. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), lunch hall (yemekhane), canteen (kantin).

5

Duru wants to find her teacher at break time. Teachers rest and talk in their own room. Duru goes to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) teachers' room

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru wants to find her teacher at break time. Teachers rest and talk in their own room.” Bu tarif “teachers' room” kelimesine uyar; teachers' room = öğretmenler odası. Diğer şıklar: library (kütüphane), sports field (spor sahası), conference hall (konferans salonu).

6

Arda looks after flowers and trees at school. He waters the plants in the outdoor green area. He works in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) school garden

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda looks after flowers and trees at school. He waters the plants in the outdoor green area.” Bu tarif “school garden” kelimesine uyar; school garden = okul bahçesi. Diğer şıklar: reading corner (okuma köşesi), classroom (sınıf), canteen (kantin).

7

Elif finishes her lesson and goes outside. She plays games in the area for children. She is in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) playground

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif finishes her lesson and goes outside. She plays games in the area for children.” Bu tarif “playground” kelimesine uyar; playground = oyun alanı. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), teachers' room (öğretmenler odası), conference hall (konferans salonu).

8

Can joins a football match at school. The teams play on a large outdoor area with goals. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) sports field

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can joins a football match at school. The teams play on a large outdoor area with goals.” Bu tarif “sports field” kelimesine uyar; sports field = spor sahası. Diğer şıklar: school garden (okul bahçesi), reading corner (okuma köşesi), library (kütüphane).

9

Nehir takes a tray and sits with her friends. They eat their school meal in a large room. It is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) lunch hall

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir takes a tray and sits with her friends. They eat their school meal in a large room.” Bu tarif “lunch hall” kelimesine uyar; lunch hall = yemekhane. Diğer şıklar: teachers' room (öğretmenler odası), playground (oyun alanı), classroom (sınıf).

10

Emir wants a small snack at break time. He buys a sandwich at a place inside the school. He visits the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) canteen

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir wants a small snack at break time. He buys a sandwich at a place inside the school.” Bu tarif “canteen” kelimesine uyar; canteen = kantin. Diğer şıklar: science lab (fen laboratuvarı), library (kütüphane), reading corner (okuma köşesi).

11

A scientist gives a talk at our school. Many students listen from rows of seats in a large room. This room is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) conference hall

Paragraftaki ipucu: “A scientist gives a talk at our school. Many students listen from rows of seats in a large room.” Bu tarif “conference hall” kelimesine uyar; conference hall = konferans salonu. Diğer şıklar: sports field (spor sahası), lunch hall (yemekhane), school garden (okul bahçesi).

12

Sena knows the person in charge of her school. He manages the school and helps teachers with their work. He is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) headmaster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena knows the person in charge of her school. He manages the school and helps teachers with their work.” Bu tarif “headmaster” kelimesine uyar; headmaster = okul müdürü. Diğer şıklar: leader (lider), P.E. teacher (beden eğitimi öğretmeni), bus driver (otobüs şoförü).

13

Baran calls the school office. A woman answers the phone and writes a note for the headmaster. She is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) secretary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran calls the school office. A woman answers the phone and writes a note for the headmaster.” Bu tarif “secretary” kelimesine uyar; secretary = sekreter. Diğer şıklar: take the bus (otobüse binmek), helpful (yardımsever), never (hiçbir zaman).

14

İpek's mother comes to a school meeting. She talks to the teacher about her child's lessons. She attends the meeting as a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) parent

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek's mother comes to a school meeting. She talks to the teacher about her child's lessons.” Bu tarif “parent” kelimesine uyar; parent = veli, ebeveyn. Diğer şıklar: leader (lider), headmaster (okul müdürü), P.E. teacher (beden eğitimi öğretmeni).

15

Tolga and I study in the same class. We have our lessons together every weekday. Tolga is my ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) classmate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga and I study in the same class. We have our lessons together every weekday.” Bu tarif “classmate” kelimesine uyar; classmate = sınıf arkadaşı. Diğer şıklar: sing in the choir (koroda şarkı söylemek), arrive (varmak), return (geri vermek).

16

Eylül travels to school on a bus. A person drives it and stops safely near the school gate. This person is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) bus driver

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül travels to school on a bus. A person drives it and stops safely near the school gate.” Bu tarif “bus driver” kelimesine uyar; bus driver = otobüs şoförü. Diğer şıklar: secretary (sekreter), parent (veli, ebeveyn), headmaster (okul müdürü).

17

Ozan learns to play basketball at school. A teacher shows him how to pass and catch the ball. This person is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) P.E. teacher

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan learns to play basketball at school. A teacher shows him how to pass and catch the ball.” Bu tarif “P.E. teacher” kelimesine uyar; P.E. teacher = beden eğitimi öğretmeni. Diğer şıklar: research (araştırmak), school trip (okul gezisi), sometimes (bazen).

18

Cemre's group chooses one person to guide the project. This person helps everyone plan their work. She is the group ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) leader

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre's group chooses one person to guide the project. This person helps everyone plan their work.” Bu tarif “leader” kelimesine uyar; leader = lider. Diğer şıklar: classmate (sınıf arkadaşı), secretary (sekreter), parent (veli, ebeveyn).

19

Yusuf enjoys making pictures. He meets friends after school to paint and draw. He joins the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) art club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf enjoys making pictures. He meets friends after school to paint and draw.” Bu tarif “art club” kelimesine uyar; art club = sanat kulübü. Diğer şıklar: experiment (deney), group project (grup projesi), talent show (yetenek gösterisi).

20

Melis likes asking how things work. Her group studies plants and does simple experiments after lessons. She belongs to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) science club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis likes asking how things work. Her group studies plants and does simple experiments after lessons.” Bu tarif “science club” kelimesine uyar; science club = bilim kulübü. Diğer şıklar: proud (gururlu), borrow (ödünç almak), practise (pratik yapmak).

21

Aras enjoys basketball and volleyball. His group meets to practise these games after school. He joins the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) sports club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras enjoys basketball and volleyball. His group meets to practise these games after school.” Bu tarif “sports club” kelimesine uyar; sports club = spor kulübü. Diğer şıklar: art club (sanat kulübü), group project (grup projesi), experiment (deney).

22

Sıla loves singing and playing the guitar. She practises songs with a school group every week. She belongs to the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) music club

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla loves singing and playing the guitar. She practises songs with a school group every week.” Bu tarif “music club” kelimesine uyar; music club = müzik kulübü. Diğer şıklar: fluent (akıcı), solve (çözmek), on time (zamanında).

23

Gökçe can dance and her friend can do magic tricks. They perform their different skills on the school stage. They take part in a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) talent show

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe can dance and her friend can do magic tricks. They perform their different skills on the school stage.” Bu tarif “talent show” kelimesine uyar; talent show = yetenek gösterisi. Diğer şıklar: science club (bilim kulübü), sports club (spor kulübü), art club (sanat kulübü).

24

Defne visits a museum with her class. Their teachers take them there for the day. This visit is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) school trip

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne visits a museum with her class. Their teachers take them there for the day.” Bu tarif “school trip” kelimesine uyar; school trip = okul gezisi. Diğer şıklar: line up (sıraya girmek), raise the flag (bayrağı göndere çekmek), celebrate (kutlamak).

25

Kerem and three classmates make one poster. Each student has a different job, and they share the work. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) group project

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem and three classmates make one poster. Each student has a different job, and they share the work.” Bu tarif “group project” kelimesine uyar; group project = grup projesi. Diğer şıklar: music club (müzik kulübü), sports club (spor kulübü), science club (bilim kulübü).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Buse wants to learn how light affects a plant. She tests two plants in different conditions and compares them. She does an ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) experiment

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse wants to learn how light affects a plant. She tests two plants in different conditions and compares them.” Bu tarif “experiment” kelimesine uyar; experiment = deney. Diğer şıklar: school trip (okul gezisi), art club (sanat kulübü), music club (müzik kulübü).

2

Deniz needs a library book for a week. He plans to take it home and return it on Friday. He wants to ______ the book.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) borrow

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz needs a library book for a week. He plans to take it home and return it on Friday.” Bu tarif “borrow” kelimesine uyar; borrow = ödünç almak. Diğer şıklar: work together (birlikte çalışmak), practise (pratik yapmak), line up (sıraya girmek).

3

İdil has two pencils. She lets her friend use one for a lesson and gets it back later. She agrees to ______ her pencil.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) lend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil has two pencils. She lets her friend use one for a lesson and gets it back later.” Bu tarif “lend” kelimesine uyar; lend = ödünç vermek. Diğer şıklar: return (geri vermek), research (araştırmak), solve (çözmek).

4

Onur checks his timetable every evening. He puts the correct books and pens in his bag. He needs to ______ his bag.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) pack

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur checks his timetable every evening. He puts the correct books and pens in his bag.” Bu tarif “pack” kelimesine uyar; pack = çantasını hazırlamak. Diğer şıklar: take the bus (otobüse binmek), raise the flag (bayrağı göndere çekmek), read a poem (şiir okumak).

5

Zeynep's first lesson starts at nine. She reaches the school gate at a quarter to nine. She likes to ______ early.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) arrive

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep's first lesson starts at nine. She reaches the school gate at a quarter to nine.” Bu tarif “arrive” kelimesine uyar; arrive = varmak. Diğer şıklar: return (geri vermek), work together (birlikte çalışmak), borrow (ödünç almak).

6

Students wait outside the classroom. They stand one behind another before entering. They ______ at the door.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) line up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Students wait outside the classroom. They stand one behind another before entering.” Bu tarif “line up” kelimesine uyar; line up = sıraya girmek. Diğer şıklar: raise the flag (bayrağı göndere çekmek), lend (ödünç vermek), research (araştırmak).

7

Our school has a special event on Republic Day. We sing songs and carry flags to mark the day. We ______ it together.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) celebrate

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our school has a special event on Republic Day. We sing songs and carry flags to mark the day.” Bu tarif “celebrate” kelimesine uyar; celebrate = kutlamak. Diğer şıklar: arrive (varmak), pack (çantasını hazırlamak), solve (çözmek).

8

Arda uses a friend's ruler during the lesson. At the end, he gives it back to its owner. He remembers to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) return

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda uses a friend's ruler during the lesson. At the end, he gives it back to its owner.” Bu tarif “return” kelimesine uyar; return = geri vermek. Diğer şıklar: read a poem (şiir okumak), take the bus (otobüse binmek), borrow (ödünç almak).

9

Mina plays the same guitar piece every day. She wants to improve before the concert. She needs to ______ regularly.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) practise

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina plays the same guitar piece every day. She wants to improve before the concert.” Bu tarif “practise” kelimesine uyar; practise = pratik yapmak. Diğer şıklar: celebrate (kutlamak), arrive (varmak), line up (sıraya girmek).

10

Ali wants facts for his school project. He checks reliable books and websites to learn about the topic. He needs to ______ it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) research

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali wants facts for his school project. He checks reliable books and websites to learn about the topic.” Bu tarif “research” kelimesine uyar; research = araştırmak. Diğer şıklar: take the bus (otobüse binmek), work together (birlikte çalışmak), lend (ödünç vermek).

11

The Turkish flag is at the bottom of the flagpole. Two students pull the rope and move it to the top. They ______ at the ceremony.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) raise the flag

Paragraftaki ipucu: “The Turkish flag is at the bottom of the flagpole. Two students pull the rope and move it to the top.” Bu tarif “raise the flag” kelimesine uyar; raise the flag = bayrağı göndere çekmek. Diğer şıklar: practise (pratik yapmak), pack (çantasını hazırlamak), celebrate (kutlamak).

12

Pelin holds a page with short verses. She says the lines clearly for everyone at the ceremony. She stands on stage to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) read a poem

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin holds a page with short verses. She says the lines clearly for everyone at the ceremony.” Bu tarif “read a poem” kelimesine uyar; read a poem = şiir okumak. Diğer şıklar: solve (çözmek), research (araştırmak), line up (sıraya girmek).

13

Efe lives far from school and does not walk there. He waits at a stop and travels with other passengers. He chooses to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) take the bus

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe lives far from school and does not walk there. He waits at a stop and travels with other passengers.” Bu tarif “take the bus” kelimesine uyar; take the bus = otobüse binmek. Diğer şıklar: return (geri vermek), celebrate (kutlamak), arrive (varmak).

14

Derya's group shares ideas for a model. Everyone helps with the same task and supports the others. They ______ to finish it.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) work together

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya's group shares ideas for a model. Everyone helps with the same task and supports the others.” Bu tarif “work together” kelimesine uyar; work together = birlikte çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: pack (çantasını hazırlamak), borrow (ödünç almak), practise (pratik yapmak).

15

Berk reads a difficult maths problem. He thinks carefully and finds the correct answer. He can ______ the problem.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) solve

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk reads a difficult maths problem. He thinks carefully and finds the correct answer.” Bu tarif “solve” kelimesine uyar; solve = çözmek. Diğer şıklar: read a poem (şiir okumak), raise the flag (bayrağı göndere çekmek), lend (ödünç vermek).

16

Sena brings her homework every school day. She does this without missing a single day. She ______ brings her homework.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) always

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena brings her homework every school day. She does this without missing a single day.” Bu tarif “always” kelimesine uyar; always = her zaman. Diğer şıklar: often (sık sık), on weekdays (hafta içi), during break time (teneffüs sırasında).

17

Burak follows the school rules. He does not shout in the library on any day. He ______ shouts there.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) never

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak follows the school rules. He does not shout in the library on any day.” Bu tarif “never” kelimesine uyar; never = hiçbir zaman. Diğer şıklar: every morning (her sabah), usually (genellikle), after school (okuldan sonra).

18

Eda walks to school on some days. On other days, her father drives her. She ______ walks to school.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) sometimes

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda walks to school on some days. On other days, her father drives her.” Bu tarif “sometimes” kelimesine uyar; sometimes = bazen. Diğer şıklar: regularly (düzenli olarak), weekly (haftalık), on weekdays (hafta içi).

19

Tuna's lesson starts at nine. He enters the classroom at nine, just as the lesson begins. He arrives ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) on time

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna's lesson starts at nine. He enters the classroom at nine, just as the lesson begins.” Bu tarif “on time” kelimesine uyar; on time = zamanında. Diğer şıklar: often (sık sık), usually (genellikle), always (her zaman).

20

Cem offers to carry his friend's books. He often helps people with their problems. He is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) helpful

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem offers to carry his friend's books. He often helps people with their problems.” Bu tarif “helpful” kelimesine uyar; helpful = yardımsever. Diğer şıklar: boring (sıkıcı), effective (etkili), careful (dikkatli).

21

Aylin wins a school prize after working hard. Her family feels happy about her achievement. They are ______ of her.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) proud

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin wins a school prize after working hard. Her family feels happy about her achievement.” Bu tarif “proud” kelimesine uyar; proud = gururlu. Diğer şıklar: fun (eğlenceli), interesting (ilginç), different (farklı).

22

Eren has the job of watering the class plants. He remembers the task and does it every day. He is a ______ student.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) responsible

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren has the job of watering the class plants. He remembers the task and does it every day.” Bu tarif “responsible” kelimesine uyar; responsible = sorumlu. Diğer şıklar: excited (heyecanlı), comfortable (rahat), busy (meşgul).

23

Nehir speaks English smoothly. She expresses her ideas easily without long pauses. Her English is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) fluent

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir speaks English smoothly. She expresses her ideas easily without long pauses.” Bu tarif “fluent” kelimesine uyar; fluent = akıcı. Diğer şıklar: exciting (heyecan verici), organised (düzenli), lucky (şanslı).

24

Baran stands in front of the whole school. He talks about the importance of reading while everyone listens. He is there to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) give a speech

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran stands in front of the whole school. He talks about the importance of reading while everyone listens.” Bu tarif “give a speech” kelimesine uyar; give a speech = konuşma yapmak. Diğer şıklar: solve (çözmek), lend (ödünç vermek), raise the flag (bayrağı göndere çekmek).

25

İpek joins a group of singers at school. They perform the same songs together at concerts. She likes to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) sing in the choir

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek joins a group of singers at school. They perform the same songs together at concerts.” Bu tarif “sing in the choir” kelimesine uyar; sing in the choir = koroda şarkı söylemek. Diğer şıklar: celebrate (kutlamak), read a poem (şiir okumak), research (araştırmak).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

classroom

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) sınıf

“classroom” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “sınıf” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki yerler” grubundandır. Örnek: Our classroom is on the first floor.

2

science lab

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) fen laboratuvarı

“science lab” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “fen laboratuvarı” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki yerler” grubundandır. Örnek: We do experiments in the science lab.

3

library

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) kütüphane

“library” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “kütüphane” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki yerler” grubundandır. Örnek: I borrow books from the library.

4

reading corner

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) okuma köşesi

“reading corner” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “okuma köşesi” olur. Bu ifade “Okuldaki yerler” grubundandır. Örnek: There are comfortable cushions in the reading corner.

5
